fields.description: Issue of Miami Life ("Florida's Most Influential Weekly") published Saturday, March 2, 1935 (Vol. 9, No. 24). Includes editorials and commentary on Miami politics and Mayor Sewell, including discussion of a proposed ordinance requiring publishers to post bond for libel suits and mention of a slander suit by the Daily Tribune. Covers local concerns about the tourist season and landlord price-gouging, and discusses gambling and enforcement in the Miami area. Contains extensive nightlife and entertainment coverage and advertising (clubs, floor shows, restaurants), along with racing and turf columns and tip services focused on Hialeah Park and related meets. Also features a full-page Better Housing/Federal Housing Administration modernization and loan information section with local contractors and lenders.
